title: On the Limits of Sparse Linear Model with Shuffled Differential Privacy
abstract: arXiv:2610.32822v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse linear regression is a fundamental problem in high-dimensional statistics, and its private counterparts leave a large gap between the central and the local model of differential privacy. Shuffled differential privacy (SDP) sits between the two, offering accuracy closer to the central model without the trust requirement of a central curator. This paper studies sparse linear regression under both non-interactive and interactive SDP protocols. In the non-interactive setting, any non-interactive $(\epsilon,\delta)$-SDP protocol is shown to incur an $\ell_2$-norm estimation error of $\Omega( \frac{\sqrt{dk}}{n\epsilon} )$ with dimension $d$, sparsity $k$, and $n$ users, revealing an inherent dimensionality barrier. In addition, a non-interactive algorithm is proposed that achieves an $\ell_2$-norm upper bound of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}( \sqrt{\frac{k}{n}} + \frac{d\sqrt{k}}{n\epsilon})$. translated_title: 关于乱序差分隐私下稀疏线性模型的极限
translated_abstract: 稀疏线性回归是高维统计中的一个基本问题，其隐私保护版本在差分隐私的中心化模型与本地化模型之间存在较大差距。乱序差分隐私介于两者之间，在无需信任中心管理者的前提下，提供接近中心化模型的精度。本文研究了非交互式与交互式乱序差分隐私（SDP）协议下的稀疏线性回归。在非交互式设定下，本文证明了任何非交互式(ε,δ)-SDP协议在维度为d、稀疏度为k、用户数为n的情况下，都会产生Ω(√(dk)/(nε))的ℓ2范数估计误差，揭示了一种固有的维度障碍。此外，本文提出了一种非交互式算法，达到了Õ(√(k/n) + d√k/(nε))的ℓ2范数误差上界。为克服这一障碍，我们转向交互式（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明了在非交互式乱序差分隐私协议下稀疏线性回归存在Ω(√(dk)/(nε))的固有维度误差下界，并提出了相应的算法，进而通过交互式协议克服该维度障碍。
en_tdlr: This paper proves an inherent Ω(√(dk)/(nε)) dimensionality lower bound for sparse linear regression under non-interactive shuffled differential privacy, proposes a matching algorithm, and overcomes this barrier via interactive protocols.
